scope: Read-only capability audit. No controller, contract, reward, training, conformance gate, or simulator implementation was changed.
governing_requirement: Confirm that acceleration, angular rate, goal-relative position, ground velocity, fix validity, and yaw are obtainable for bcod-sim, VRX, and Gazebo Harmonic in the shared contract units and NED/body conventions.

vrx.conclusion: The blocking AHRS sub-check passes: WAM-V publishes a populated orientation and does not use the covariance[0] == -1 unavailability sentinel. ROS NavSatFix does not carry ground velocity.

gazebo_harmonic.gps_live_observation: Only header and frame_id serialized because all numeric NavSat values remained protobuf-default zero.
gazebo_harmonic.conclusion: The sensor entities and world systems work under pinned Harmonic 8.15. The generated world has no spherical_coordinates/geodetic origin, so live NavSat position and velocity are not yet meaningful.

vrx_trace_exporter.py.finding: Subscribes to Odometry, Imu, and NavSatFix. It copies IMU vectors without FLU-to-contract-body conversion, uses odometry for N/E and velocity, uses GPS only for status, and discards IMU orientation.

task-trace-bridge.ts.finding: Its existing ENU-to-NED odometry conversion correctly maps N=y, E=x, yaw=pi/2-yaw_ENU, and yaw rate=-angular_z. Its sample interface has no NavSat position/velocity or IMU orientation fields, and the observation path derives goal position and ground velocity from odometry.

prepare-gazebo-episode.ts.finding: Correctly enables task_imu/task_gps with phaseASensors=true, but the emitted world has no spherical_coordinates block.

field_parity.gap: VRX/Gazebo IMU data is emitted in Gazebo/ROS body FLU conventions; the current VRX exporter forwards x/y/z unchanged. The shared body convention requires explicit axis/sign conversion and a fixed gravity/specific-force convention.
The current VRX exporter forwards FLU angular rates unchanged; roll/pitch/yaw-rate signs must be mapped to the shared body convention.

Neither existing wrapper converts geodetic fixes to the task local tangent origin. Gazebo's generated world also lacks the spherical origin needed to emit meaningful coordinates. Current wrappers substitute true odometry.

field_parity.gazebo_harmonic: available as velocity_north/east/up in native gz.msgs.NavSat once geodetic setup is valid
field_parity.gap: The VRX wrapper currently substitutes odometry velocity. A sensor-side velocity source or an explicitly documented non-learned position-difference estimator is required; true odometry is not parity with the bcod-sim GPS observation.
Gazebo needs a documented validity rule based on topic/sample freshness and finite configured geodetic output, or an explicit deviation.

field_parity.vrx: available from live IMU quaternion; covariance[0]=0
field_parity.gazebo_harmonic: available from live IMU quaternion; covariance[0]=0
field_parity.gap: External quaternion yaw must be converted from ENU to NED and wrapped consistently; current wrappers discard it.

orientation_scope_decision_for_task_4.reason: Orientation is live and populated in all three backends, including the explicitly checked WAM-V topic.
orientation_scope_decision_for_task_4.caveat: The remaining parity gaps are confined to the VRX/Gazebo adapters and block Phase 2 or any cross-simulator PPO execution. They do not block the bcod-sim-only Task 4 contract revision or Task 5 diagnostic run. No silent odometry substitution is acceptable when external execution resumes.

required_next_work: Add a geodetic origin to generated Gazebo/VRX Surveyor worlds and verify nonzero position and velocity during a controlled motion.
Define and test FLU/ENU to shared body-NED mappings for IMU vectors and yaw.
Choose a VRX sensor-side ground-velocity source or document a non-learned NavSat finite-difference estimator; do not use privileged odometry as if it were GPS.
Define Gazebo NavSat validity semantics from freshness and finite data, or record an explicit deviation.
Update the wrappers before Phase 2 or any cross-simulator PPO execution, then repeat this audit.

execution_scope.vrx_odometry_deviation: The current ground-velocity substitution is explicitly recorded as privileged odometry, not a GPS-derived measurement, and must not quietly become the portable baseline.

unchanged_gates: VRX Gate 7, Gazebo SDF inertia, and Gate 5 fairness remain in force and are neither passed nor waived by this audit.
